alerts_explained.explanation: High error rates in several services caused by upstream product-catalog unavailability.
A pod in otel-demo namespace is stuck pending due to ImagePullBackOff.
Services report zero traffic because upstream checkout cannot complete requests.
System health check always firing; indicates alerting pipeline is functional.
